html:
<style>
  /* Strata: the scaffold's own glue. Every control is a shipped component (Border Layout, Panel, Resizer, Data Tree,
     Property Tree, Data Grid, Tabs, Button Group, Toggle Group, Input, Select, Textarea, Switch, Label, Badge, Table,
     Progress, Alert, Dialog, Alert Dialog, Toast, Swap, Language Switcher, Spinner) */
  .dx {
    position: relative;
    block-size: var(--scaffold-height, 50rem);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .dx [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .dx-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .dx-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    & small {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-weight: 400;
    }
  }
  .dx-mark {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    inline-size: 1.75rem;
    block-size: 1.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  .dx-mark svg,
  .dx-ico svg {
    inline-size: 1rem;
    block-size: 1rem;
  }
  .dx-ico {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .dx-mono,
  .dx code,
  .dx-json {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  .dx-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    block-size: 100%;
    & .data-tree {
      flex: 1;
      min-block-size: 0;
    }
  }
  .data-tree-label:has(> .dx-node) {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .dx-node {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    & > span:nth-child(2) {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & small {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
  }
  /* a row's button lies over the end of its row (over the count) - hidden, it takes no room from the name */
  .data-tree-item:has(.dx-node-act) {
    position: relative;
  }
  .dx-node-act.btn {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: 0.375rem;
    inset-block: 0;
    margin-block: auto;
    block-size: 1.375rem;
    opacity: 0;
    background: var(--accent);
    & svg {
      inline-size: 0.875rem;
      block-size: 0.875rem;
    }
    &[data-size='xs'] {
      gap: 0.125rem;
      padding-inline: 0.375rem;
    }
  }
  .data-tree-item[aria-selected='true'] .dx-node-act.btn {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 14%, var(--card));
  }
  .data-tree-item:is(:hover, [aria-selected='true']) .dx-node-act,
  .data-tree:focus-visible .data-tree-item[data-active] .dx-node-act,
  .dx-node-act:focus-visible {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  /* the count gives way to the + while it shows (the button is narrower than a count such as 12,000) */
  .data-tree-item:is(:hover, [aria-selected='true']):has(.dx-node-act) small,
  .data-tree:focus-visible .data-tree-item[data-active]:has(.dx-node-act) small,
  .data-tree-item:has(.dx-node-act:focus-visible) small {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  @media (hover: none) {
    .dx-node-act.btn {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
  .dx-main {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-block-size: 0;
    block-size: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .dx-crumbs {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-inline-size: 0;
    & a {
      color: inherit;
    }
  }
  /* a narrow query bar: a row of several fields becomes label | field pairs, its buttons at the end */
  @container dx-query (inline-size < 44rem) {
    .dx-q-row:has(> .dx-q-label ~ .dx-q-label) {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      & > .select {
        justify-self: start;
      }
      & > .btn {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        justify-self: end;
      }
      & > .flex-1 {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  }
  .dx-query {
    container: dx-query / inline-size;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .dx-q-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    & .input {
      flex: 1 1 12rem;
      min-inline-size: 0;
    }
    & .select {
      inline-size: auto;
    }
  }
  .dx-q-label {
    flex: none;
    min-inline-size: 4.25rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  /* the suggestions: one list under the field being typed in (anchored to it), opened at the word */
  .dx-ac {
    position: fixed;
    position-anchor: --dx-ac;
    inset: auto;
    top: anchor(bottom);
    left: anchor(left);
    position-try-fallbacks: flip-block;
    translate: var(--dx-ac-x, 0) 0;
    margin: 2px 0 0;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    min-inline-size: 14rem;
    max-inline-size: min(28rem, 90vw);
    max-block-size: 16rem;
    overflow: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--popover);
    color: var(--popover-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  }
  .dx-ac-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    &[aria-selected='true'] {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent-foreground);
    }
    &:hover {
      background: var(--muted);
    }
  }
  .dx-ac-kind {
    flex: none;
    inline-size: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .dx-ac-item[data-kind='operator'] .dx-ac-kind {
    color: var(--chart-2);
  }
  .dx-ac-item[data-kind='field'] .dx-ac-kind {
    color: var(--chart-1);
  }
  .dx-ac-label {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .dx-ac-detail {
    flex: none;
    max-inline-size: 14rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  .dx-syntax {
    margin: -0.25rem 0 0 4.75rem;
    color: var(--destructive);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  .dx-query .input[aria-invalid='true'] {
    border-color: var(--destructive);
  }
  .dx-help {
    inline-size: min(26rem, 92vw);
  }
  .dx-help-ops {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    & dd {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
  }
  .dx-help-keys {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* the aggregation builder: keys and measures side by side, a row per key / measure */
  .dx-agg-parts {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(18rem, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .dx-agg-part {
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    justify-items: start;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.625rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    min-inline-size: 0;
  }
  .dx-agg-legend {
    padding-inline: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .dx-agg-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    justify-self: stretch;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .dx-agg-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    & .input {
      flex: 1 1 8rem;
      min-inline-size: 0;
    }
    & .select {
      inline-size: auto;
      flex: 0 1 11rem;
    }
  }
  .dx-values {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .dx-none {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-style: italic;
  }
  /* the labels, legends and tabs lead with an icon */
  .dx-q-label,
  .dx-agg-legend {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  .dx-q-label svg,
  .dx-agg-legend svg,
  .dx .tab-trigger svg,
  .dx-foot > svg {
    inline-size: 0.875rem;
    block-size: 0.875rem;
    flex: none;
  }
  .dx .tab-trigger {
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  /* the foot of a result: what is shown, the plan and the pages - kept in view while the list scrolls */
  .dx-foot {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding-block: 0.5rem 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .dx-json-view {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-block-size: 0;
    grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    overflow: hidden;
    & .dx-json {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
      max-block-size: none;
    }
  }
  .dx-json-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* token colours (the theme has no syntax tokens): literal, readable on --muted in both modes */
  .dx-t-key {
    color: light-dark(oklch(0.45 0.15 260), oklch(0.78 0.11 250));
  }
  .dx-t-str {
    color: light-dark(oklch(0.48 0.13 150), oklch(0.8 0.13 150));
  }
  .dx-t-num {
    color: light-dark(oklch(0.5 0.15 50), oklch(0.8 0.12 60));
  }
  .dx-t-lit {
    color: light-dark(oklch(0.48 0.17 330), oklch(0.78 0.13 330));
  }
  .dx-t-fn {
    color: light-dark(oklch(0.45 0.16 290), oklch(0.78 0.12 290));
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .dx-t-key,
    .dx-t-str,
    .dx-t-num,
    .dx-t-lit,
    .dx-t-fn {
      color: CanvasText;
    }
    /* forced colours paint the field's own text: the twin under it would double it */
    .dx-code .dx-code-paint {
      visibility: hidden;
    }
  }
  /* Indexes: the form, then the list - or, without one, the empty state in the middle of what is left */
  .dx [data-dx-view='coll']:not([hidden]),
  #dx-p-idx:not([hidden]),
  #dx-p-agg:not([hidden]) {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1 0 auto;
  }
  #dx-p-idx:not([hidden]),
  #dx-p-agg:not([hidden]) {
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* Documents: the query bar and the foot stay, the records scroll in their own box between them (all three
     views: the List scrolls the box, the Table and the JSON fill it and scroll themselves) */
  .dx [data-dx-view='coll']:not([hidden]):has(> #dx-p-docs:not([hidden])) {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-block-size: 0;
  }
  #dx-p-docs:not([hidden]) {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    min-block-size: 0;
  }
  #dx-p-docs [data-dx-results] {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-block-size: 14rem;
    overflow: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    /* a batch put in above keeps the reader's place by script, in every browser */
    overflow-anchor: none;
  }
  #dx-p-docs [data-dx-results]:has(> .dx-grid-host, > .dx-json-view) {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .dx-idx-empty:not([hidden]) {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1;
    place-items: center;
  }
  .dx-import-sample {
    margin: 0.375rem 0 0;
    max-block-size: 7rem;
    overflow: auto;
    white-space: pre;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* the Schema tab's As of: as wide as a date and time, beside the view switch */
  .dx-schema-at {
    inline-size: 14rem;
    flex: none;
  }
  .dx-results-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .dx-docs {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    container: dx-docs / inline-size;
  }
  @container dx-docs (inline-size < 56rem) {
    .dx-doc-head .dx-act-label {
      position: absolute;
      inline-size: 1px;
      block-size: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip-path: inset(50%);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  }
  /* a document is one row (its id and a preview of its fields) until it is opened - a native <details> */
  .dx-doc {
    display: block;
    /* a long list lays out and paints only the cards near the view (VERIFIED tmp/probe-dx-list.ts: a batch's long
       task 63-95 ms, growing with the list, gone with it); a folded card is 38px, an opened one keeps its last size */
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-block-size: auto 38px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    &[data-dirty] {
      border-color: var(--ring);
    }
    &[open] .dx-doc-head {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--muted);
      &::before {
        rotate: 135deg;
      }
    }
  }
  .dx-doc-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem 0.25rem 0.625rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    &::-webkit-details-marker {
      display: none;
    }
    /* the disclosure chevron: turns down when the row opens */
    &::before {
      content: '';
      flex: none;
      inline-size: 0.4rem;
      block-size: 0.4rem;
      margin-inline-end: 0.125rem;
      border-block-start: 1.5px solid currentColor;
      border-inline-end: 1.5px solid currentColor;
      rotate: 45deg;
      transition: rotate 0.15s;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
    &:hover {
      background: var(--muted);
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }
    & .dx-doc-id {
      flex: none;
      max-inline-size: 40%;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & .dx-doc-preview {
      flex: 1;
      min-inline-size: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .dx-doc-head::before {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  /* a badge with an icon (a collection's History / Timestamps): the Badge sets no gap of its own */
  .dx .badge:has(> svg) {
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .dx-revs {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0.25rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .dx-rev {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    margin: -0.25rem -0.375rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.375rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    &:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent-foreground);
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: 1px;
    }
    &:disabled {
      cursor: default;
    }
    &[aria-pressed='true'] .timeline-title {
      color: var(--primary);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
  }
  /* the insert dialog's JSON: a transparent textarea over its painted twin - the textarea stays the field (caret,
     selection, undo, the form), the paint under it shows the same text coloured like the JSON view */
  .dx-code {
    position: relative;
    & textarea,
    & .dx-code-paint {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      tab-size: 2;
      scrollbar-gutter: stable;
    }
    & textarea {
      display: block;
      min-block-size: 16rem;
      max-block-size: 60dvh;
      overflow: auto;
      color: transparent;
      caret-color: var(--foreground);
      background: var(--background);
      border-color: var(--input);
    }
    & textarea::selection {
      color: transparent;
      background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 30%, transparent);
    }
    & .dx-code-paint {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      color: var(--foreground);
      background: transparent;
    }
  }
  .dx-ins-tabs .tab-panel {
    padding-block-start: 0.5rem;
  }
  .dx-ins-tree {
    --property-tree-row-height: 1.75rem;
    block-size: 16rem;
  }
  .dx-doc .property-tree {
    --property-tree-row-height: 1.75rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  .dx-json {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--muted);
    overflow: auto;
    max-block-size: 32rem;
    white-space: pre;
  }
  /* the Table and JSON views fill the records' box */
  .dx-grid-host {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-block-size: 0;
  }
  .dx-grid-host .data-grid,
  .dx-json-lines {
    block-size: 100%;
  }
  /* Virtual List reads its row height once, in px */
  .dx-json-lines {
    --virtual-list-row-height: 20px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: transparent;
    & .virtual-list-row {
      display: block;
      padding-inline: 0.75rem;
      border: 0;
      font: inherit;
      line-height: 20px;
      white-space: pre;
    }
  }
  .dx-bars {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    & .progress {
      flex: 1;
      min-inline-size: 4rem;
    }
  }
  .dx-history {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.375rem;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .dx-history-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    &:hover {
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    & button.dx-run {
      all: unset;
      cursor: pointer;
      min-inline-size: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    & button.dx-run:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    }
    & small {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
    }
  }
  .dx-log {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    list-style: none;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    & li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 6.5rem 1fr auto;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding-block: 0.125rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    & time,
    & .dx-ms {
      color: var(--muted-foreground);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    & [data-failed] {
      color: var(--destructive);
    }
  }
  .dx-empty {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-inline-size: 48rem;
    & > :is(h2, p) {
      margin: 0;
    }
  }
  .dx-cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(14rem, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .dx-db-card {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    &:hover {
      border-color: var(--ring);
    }
  }
  .dx-form {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    & .field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.375rem;
    }
  }
  .dx-opt-field {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 0.125rem 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    & .dx-hint {
      grid-column: 2;
    }
  }
  .dx-zone {
    inline-size: 11rem;
  }
